brief.meaningEn: A book so engaging that readers want to keep reading.
brief.meaningZh: 情節引人入勝、令人想一直讀下去的書。
brief.grammar: Pattern: a page-turner (singular count noun), page-turners (plural). A book or story can be a page-turner; describe engagement, not physical page turning.
brief.register: Informal positive book review: a bookseller, reader or reviewer recommends a hard-to-put-down story to a friend; the phrase does not refer merely to page count.
brief.boundaryZh: 重點是故事持續吸引讀者；薄書、字大或翻頁很快並不足以稱為 page-turner。
brief.misconceptionZh: 不要把 page-turner 只理解為要翻頁的實體書；電子書也可以。
brief.outcomeZh: 能指出書中哪項敘事安排令讀者想繼續讀。

sources.file: Idiomatic and Natural English Expressions Books 10 to 16 Part 3.docx
sources.locatorNote: DOCX table 23, row 11; page refers to the locally rendered PDF recorded in the intake summary.
sources.sentence: Her crime novels are genuine page-turners.

listening.en: Lena planned to read one chapter of the mystery before bed, but each chapter ended with a fresh question. She stayed up to finish it and called the book a page-turner.
listening.zh: 莉娜原打算睡前讀一章懸疑小說，但每章結尾都有新問題。她讀到很晚才看完，並稱這本書令人欲罷不能。
listening.promptZh: 莉娜為何稱這本書為 page-turner？

options.en: Each new question made her eager to read the next chapter.
options.zh: 每個新問題都令她急於讀下一章。

options.en: The large print let her turn each page more quickly.
options.zh: 大字體令她較快翻頁。

options.en: The book was short enough to finish in one sitting.
options.zh: 這本書很短，能一次讀完。

options.en: She had to finish it for a class deadline.
options.zh: 她因課堂期限而必須讀完。

listening.explanationZh: 她因懸念而主動想繼續讀；頁數、字體與作業期限都不能單獨證明故事引人入勝。

reply.promptEn: Why would you recommend this mystery novel to the reading group?
reply.promptZh: （你為何會向讀書會推薦這本懸疑小說？）

options.en: Each chapter reveals a clue that changes how readers see the case.
options.zh: 每章都有線索，改變讀者對案件的看法。

options.en: The characters make decisions that are worth discussing together.
options.zh: 角色作出的決定值得大家討論。

options.en: It is a page-turner that keeps readers curious until the last chapter.
options.zh: 它是一本令人欲罷不能的書，令讀者直到最後一章仍充滿好奇。

options.en: Its ending gives the group several questions to debate.
options.zh: 它的結局給讀書會留下幾個可討論的問題。

reply.explanationZh: 四句都能合理解釋推薦理由；金句直接指出小說持續吸引讀者。

options.en: It is a page-turner because each chapter makes readers want the next one.
options.zh: 這是一本令人欲罷不能的書，因為每章都令人想讀下一章。

options.en: It may be easy to finish because the chapters are short, even if the plot does not hold attention.
options.zh: 即使情節不吸引人，篇章短也可能令人容易讀完。

options.en: Students borrow it mainly because the cover is colourful, without discussing the story.
options.zh: 學生主要因封面色彩鮮艷而借書，並沒有談論故事。

scene.explanationZh: 學生因接續的危機而自願追讀，重點是持續的敘事吸引力；短篇幅或封面不足以證明。
scene.promptZh: 一本冒險小說每章都留下新危機，學生自願借下一冊，想知道人物如何脫險。哪句最貼切？

options.en: A mystery novel reveals a new clue at the end of each chapter.
options.zh: 懸疑小說每章末都揭示一條新線索。

options.en: A reference manual has clear labels and is useful when a repair is needed, but readers consult only the relevant page.
options.zh: 參考手冊標示清楚，維修時很有用，但讀者只查閱相關頁面。

options.en: A fantasy story gives readers a reason to follow the characters into the next chapter.
options.zh: 奇幻故事讓讀者想跟着角色讀下一章。

contrast.explanationZh: 實用手冊可很有價值，但它在這裏供人按需查閱，沒有令人追着情節一直讀的特點。
contrast.promptZh: 哪本書最不適合稱為 page-turner？

options.en: That sounds like a real page-turner; the suspense keeps drawing you on.
options.zh: 聽起來真是一本令人欲罷不能的書；懸念令你想繼續讀。

options.en: It may simply have few pages, so finishing it takes less time.
options.zh: 它可能只是頁數少，因此讀完所需時間較短。

options.en: Perhaps the illustrations are attractive, even if the chapters do not connect.
options.zh: 或許插圖很吸引，即使篇章之間沒有連貫。

dialogue.explanationZh: 朋友明確說想知道下一章發展，重點是故事持續引起好奇，不只是短或圖畫好看。
dialogue.promptZh: 朋友說：「我本來只想看十分鐘，卻一直想知道下一章會發生甚麼。」你怎樣回應最自然？

speaking.en: The novel is a page-turner because each new clue changes what we think happened.
speaking.zh: 這本小說令人欲罷不能，因為每條新線索都改變我們對事件的理解。
speaking.promptZh: 先聽示範，再說出讓讀者想繼續讀的安排。

writing.promptZh: 新情境：學校圖書館的一本短篇奇幻小說，每章結尾都留下未解的問題，同學自願借閱並追問下一章。用一至兩句英文推薦這本書。
writing.selfCheckZh: 指出每章末的未解問題，以及同學自願追讀；不要只說書薄或字大。

examples.en: The fantasy book is a page-turner: every chapter ends with an unanswered question, so students keep borrowing it to see what happens next.
examples.zh: 這本奇幻書令人欲罷不能：每章都以未解問題作結，學生於是不斷借閱，想知道其後發展。

examples.en: Students ask for the next chapter because each ending leaves a fresh mystery; the library has a real page-turner on its shelves.
examples.zh: 每章結尾都留下新謎團，學生便追問下一章；圖書館藏書裏有一本令人欲罷不能的書。

takeaways.en: That detective story is a page-turner from its first clue to its final answer.
takeaways.zh: 那本偵探故事從首條線索到最後答案都令人欲罷不能。

takeaways.en: A page-turner gives readers a reason to keep reading, not merely a quick page count.
takeaways.zh: 令人欲罷不能的書有讓讀者繼續讀的理由，不只是頁數少。

notes: AI-authored provisional draft; independent English, Chinese, media and QA review remain pending.

brief.meaningEn: Start or continue necessary work instead of delaying it.
brief.meaningZh: 不再拖延，着手或繼續完成眼前該做的工作。
brief.grammar: Pattern: get/gets/got on with + the job, work or a named task. The with phrase supplies the activity; get on with the job means proceed or resume it.
brief.register: Practical everyday direction: a team leader or coworker tells colleagues to resume an identifiable task after a delay or distraction.
brief.boundaryZh: 可在準備妥當後開始，也可在受阻後繼續；不表示工作已經完成或做得倉卒。
brief.misconceptionZh: 不要把 get on with 混成與某人相處融洽；這裏的 with the job 指眼前工作。
brief.outcomeZh: 能說明甚麼阻礙已解除，以及接下來可做哪項具體工作。

sources.file: Idiomatic and Natural English Expressions Books 10 to 16 Part 3.docx
sources.locatorNote: DOCX table 24, row 8; page refers to the locally rendered PDF recorded in the intake summary.
sources.sentence: The cleaner can get on with the job while we prepare dinner.

listening.en: The community kitchen had waited for its food delivery all morning. Once the ingredients arrived, the cooks got on with the job of preparing lunch for the residents.
listening.zh: 社區食堂整個上午等候食材送到。材料一到，廚師便着手為居民準備午餐。
listening.promptZh: 食材到達後，廚師怎樣 got on with the job？

options.en: They began preparing lunch once the ingredients arrived.
options.zh: 食材一到，他們便開始準備午餐。

options.en: They reported that every meal was already finished.
options.zh: 他們說所有餐點早已完成。

options.en: They continued discussing the delivery instead of cooking.
options.zh: 他們繼續討論送貨，沒有開始煮食。

options.en: They changed the menu but left the ingredients untouched.
options.zh: 他們改了菜單，卻沒有使用已到的食材。

listening.explanationZh: 食材到達解除等待，廚師隨即開始必要工作；get on with the job 不等於已完成。

reply.promptEn: What did the volunteers do once the garden tools arrived?
reply.promptZh: （園藝工具送到後，義工做了甚麼？）

options.en: They began clearing the path they had planned to repair.
options.zh: 他們開始清理原定修整的小徑。

options.en: They divided the weeding work and started at the flower beds.
options.zh: 他們分配除草工作，從花圃開始。

options.en: They got on with the job of preparing the new planting area.
options.zh: 他們着手準備新的種植區。

options.en: They used the tools to turn the soil for the seedlings.
options.zh: 他們用工具為幼苗翻土。

reply.explanationZh: 四句都回答工具到達後義工實際做了甚麼；金句概括不再拖延地着手工作。

options.en: The host got on with the job of leading the workshop.
options.zh: 主持人着手帶領工作坊。

options.en: The host marked the workshop complete before the exercises began.
options.zh: 練習尚未開始，主持人已把工作坊標成完成。

options.en: The host kept revising the plan although everyone was ready.
options.zh: 大家已準備好，主持人卻繼續修改計劃。

scene.explanationZh: 條件已齊，主持人開始原定工作；並非提前宣告完成或繼續拖延。
scene.promptZh: 工作坊的桌椅已準備好，參加者也已到齊；主持人停止閒談，開始按計劃帶領練習。哪句最貼切？

options.en: The repairer starts fixing the door as soon as the part arrives.
options.zh: 零件一到，維修員便開始修門。

options.en: The team spends the whole afternoon debating whose task it is and makes no start.
options.zh: 團隊整個下午都在爭論由誰負責，沒有着手工作。

options.en: The staff resume packing after a delayed delivery reaches them.
options.zh: 延誤的貨物到達後，職員恢復包裝。

contrast.explanationZh: 整個下午只有爭論而未開始工作，與着手或繼續工作相反。
contrast.promptZh: 哪個情況最不適合用 get on with the job？

options.en: Let us get on with the job and start with the first items on the list.
options.zh: 我們着手做吧，先處理清單上的首幾項。

options.en: We should wait for another meeting, even though the plan is already agreed.
options.zh: 計劃雖已商定，我們仍應等另一次會議。

options.en: The list is ready, so we can tell everyone the work is finished.
options.zh: 清單已備妥，我們就可以說工作完成了。

dialogue.explanationZh: 計劃與材料已齊，最自然是開始清單上的工作；開會拖延和假稱完成都不貼切。
dialogue.promptZh: 同事說：「清單和材料都齊了，我們還在反覆討論第一步。」你如何回應最合適？

speaking.en: Once the safety check was complete, the team got on with the job of setting up the stage.
speaking.zh: 安全檢查完成後，團隊便着手搭建舞台。
speaking.promptZh: 先聽示範，再指出哪項工作接着開始。

writing.promptZh: 新情境：社區中心的閱讀活動因桌椅尚未送到而延遲。桌椅送達後，義工立即排好座位並開始接待家庭。用一至兩句英文描述行動。
writing.selfCheckZh: 指出等候桌椅的阻礙、桌椅到達，以及義工開始排座位和接待家庭；不要說活動已全部完成。

examples.en: The tables and chairs arrived after a delay, so the volunteers got on with the job of arranging seats and welcoming families.
examples.zh: 桌椅延遲送到，義工便着手排座位並接待家庭。

examples.en: Once the tables and chairs were delivered, we got on with the job: we set out the seats and greeted the arriving families.
examples.zh: 桌椅送達後，我們便着手工作：排好座位，迎接陸續到達的家庭。

takeaways.en: When the permit arrived, the organisers got on with the job of preparing the event.
takeaways.zh: 許可證到手後，主辦者便着手籌備活動。

takeaways.en: We got on with the job after the missing equipment was replaced.
takeaways.zh: 缺少的設備補齊後，我們便繼續工作。

notes: AI-authored provisional draft; independent English, Chinese, media and QA review remain pending.

brief.meaningEn: Improve a method so the same aim takes less wasted effort, rather than merely increasing effort.
brief.meaningZh: 改良工作方法，減少白費的力氣，而不是單純更用力或做更久。
brief.grammar: Pattern: work smarter rather than harder. Smarter and harder function as comparative adverbs modifying work; do not add more before smarter.
brief.register: Practical efficiency advice: a teammate or manager tells colleagues how a better method saves effort while preserving necessary quality checks.
brief.boundaryZh: 重點是方法更有效率，並保留必要的品質；不是偷工減料，也不是叫人完全不努力。
brief.misconceptionZh: 不要把縮短時間自動當成 smarter；如果漏了必要檢查，可能只是省略工作。
brief.outcomeZh: 能指出舊方法浪費了甚麼，以及新方法如何在維持品質下改善。

sources.file: Idiomatic and Natural English Expressions Books 10 to 16 Part 3.docx
sources.locatorNote: DOCX table 25, row 4; page refers to the locally rendered PDF recorded in the intake summary.
sources.sentence: A clear checklist helps us work smarter rather than harder.

listening.en: The school fair team kept copying names into three separate lists. They made one shared form with a final check for errors, helping everyone work smarter rather than harder.
listening.zh: 學校嘉年華團隊一直把姓名抄進三份不同名單。他們改用共用表格，最後仍核對錯誤，令大家用更有效率的方法工作。
listening.promptZh: 新表格如何讓團隊 work smarter rather than harder？

options.en: It removed repeated copying while keeping an error check.
options.zh: 它減少重複抄寫，同時保留錯誤核對。

options.en: It let the team skip checking names to save time.
options.zh: 它讓團隊省去核對姓名以節省時間。

options.en: It required everyone to copy each name more carefully into all three lists.
options.zh: 它要求大家更仔細地把每個姓名抄進三份名單。

options.en: It reduced the number of people allowed to register.
options.zh: 它減少可登記的人數。

listening.explanationZh: 共用表格減少重複工作，仍保留核對；省略查核或單純更用力都不符合。

reply.promptEn: What changes helped your club sort the donated books more efficiently?
reply.promptZh: （你們社團採取甚麼方法，令捐贈書籍整理工作更有效率？）

options.en: We used one shared list so no one entered the same title twice.
options.zh: 我們用一份共用清單，避免同一本書重複輸入。

options.en: We grouped the books by subject before checking the titles.
options.zh: 我們先按主題分書，再核對書名。

options.en: We worked smarter rather than harder by scanning each barcode once and reviewing the final list.
options.zh: 我們每本書只掃描條碼一次，再核對最終清單，用更聰明的方法工作。

options.en: We used box labels to send books to the right table, then checked each shelf.
options.zh: 我們用箱上的標籤把書送到合適的桌子，再核對每個書架。

reply.explanationZh: 四句都說明減少重複、分流或核對的有效方法；金句明確概括改良流程，而非單純增加工時。

options.en: They worked smarter rather than harder by sharing one checked address list.
options.zh: 他們共用一份經核對的地址表，以更有效率的方法工作。

options.en: They worked faster by removing the final check, even if deliveries could go to the wrong place.
options.zh: 他們取消最後核對來加快速度，即使可能送錯地址。

options.en: They increased everyone’s typing hours while keeping the duplicate lists.
options.zh: 他們保留重複名單，並增加每人的打字時間。

scene.explanationZh: 共用且核對過的地址表減少重複輸入，同時維持準確；其餘選項不是改善方法。
scene.promptZh: 義工每人都重複打同一批地址。協調員改用一份共用地址表，保留最後核對，減少重複工作。哪句最貼切？

options.en: A team uses a reusable template and still checks the final details.
options.zh: 團隊使用可重用範本，仍核對最終細節。

options.en: A team skips the safety check solely to finish sooner.
options.zh: 團隊純粹為了早點完成，省去安全檢查。

options.en: A team divides tasks by skill and reviews the combined result.
options.zh: 團隊按各人所長分工，並檢查合併結果。

contrast.explanationZh: 省去必要安全檢查是減少品質保障，不是改良工作方法。
contrast.promptZh: 哪個做法最不符合 work smarter rather than harder？

options.en: A shared import could help us work smarter rather than harder if we still verify the entries.
options.zh: 若仍核對資料，共用匯入功能可令我們用更有效率的方法工作。

options.en: We could keep both entries and simply stay an hour later each day.
options.zh: 我們可保留兩次輸入，每天再晚一小時下班。

options.en: We could stop checking both systems, even if duplicate entries cause errors.
options.zh: 即使重複輸入導致錯誤，我們也可停止核對兩個系統。

dialogue.explanationZh: 共用匯入減少重複工序，仍核對資料；加班和省略核對都未改善流程。
dialogue.promptZh: 同事說：「我們每天加班，還要把同一筆資料輸入兩個系統。」你如何回應最貼切？

speaking.en: A shared template let the editors work smarter rather than harder while keeping the final proofread.
speaking.zh: 共用範本減少編輯的重複工作，同時保留最後校對，讓他們用更聰明的方法工作。
speaking.promptZh: 先聽示範，再說出新方法節省甚麼及保留哪項檢查。

writing.promptZh: 新情境：學校義工原本逐人傳訊確認活動時間，經常重複回覆。團隊改用共用報名表，但仍由一人核對資料。用一至兩句英文描述改善。
writing.selfCheckZh: 指出舊方法需逐人傳訊、共用報名表減少重複回覆，而且仍有人核對；不要把省略核對當成效率。

examples.en: The volunteers used to message each family separately; a shared sign-up form helped them work smarter rather than harder while one person checked the entries.
examples.zh: 義工原本逐一傳訊給每個家庭；共用報名表減少重複工作，並由一人核對資料，令團隊用更有效率的方法工作。

examples.en: By replacing repeated messages with one shared registration form and keeping a final data check, the team worked smarter rather than harder.
examples.zh: 團隊以共用報名表取代重複訊息，仍保留最後資料核對，用更聰明的方法工作。

takeaways.en: A single schedule helped the staff work smarter rather than harder without dropping the review step.
takeaways.zh: 一份共用時間表令職員在保留核對程序下，以更有效率的方法工作。

takeaways.en: We can work smarter rather than harder by checking the form once instead of copying it three times.
takeaways.zh: 表格核對一次而非抄寫三次，我們便能用更有效率的方法工作。

notes: AI-authored provisional draft; independent English, Chinese, media and QA review remain pending.

brief.meaningEn: Stop completely after progressing, rather than merely slowing down.
brief.meaningZh: 原本在進行的事情完全停下來，而不只是變慢。
brief.grammar: Pattern: grind/grinds/ground to a halt; a service, project or vehicle is the subject. Ground is the past form of grind here; to a halt completes the phrase.
brief.register: Vivid neutral-to-negative report: a project manager, commuter or colleague tells someone why a service or activity stopped making progress entirely.
brief.boundaryZh: 要有原本在運作而後完全停止的過程；延遲、放慢或短暫改道未必符合。
brief.misconceptionZh: 不要把 halt 只看作車輛煞停；也不要把仍有部分進度的活動說成完全停頓。
brief.outcomeZh: 能指出甚麼關鍵障礙使哪項活動完全停止。

sources.file: Idiomatic and Natural English Expressions Books 10 to 16 Part 3.docx
sources.locatorNote: DOCX table 25, row 9; page refers to the locally rendered PDF recorded in the intake summary.
sources.sentence: The project ground to a halt when the supplier failed.

listening.en: The local paper lost access to its files, and its backup system also failed. With no pages ready to print, production ground to a halt for the day.
listening.zh: 本地報紙無法存取檔案，後備系統也故障。沒有頁面可供印刷，當天的製作工作完全停頓。
listening.promptZh: 這裏的 ground to a halt 表示甚麼？

options.en: The paper could not continue production that day.
options.zh: 報紙當天無法繼續製作。

options.en: The paper printed fewer pages but continued publishing.
options.zh: 報紙少印幾頁，但仍繼續出版。

options.en: The editors shifted to another computer and kept working.
options.zh: 編輯轉用另一部電腦，繼續工作。

options.en: The paper finished printing before the files became inaccessible.
options.zh: 檔案無法存取前，報紙已印好。

listening.explanationZh: 主系統與後備都無法使用，當天沒有頁面可印，屬完全停止；減量或改用其他設備只是繼續運作。

reply.promptEn: What happened to deliveries when the only road to the village was closed?
reply.promptZh: （通往村莊唯一的道路封閉後，送貨情況怎樣？）

options.en: No vehicles could bring supplies into the village that day.
options.zh: 當天沒有車輛能把物資送進村莊。

options.en: The drivers had to stop all village deliveries until the road reopened.
options.zh: 司機只得暫停所有往村莊的送貨，待道路重開。

options.en: Deliveries ground to a halt because there was no alternative route.
options.zh: 沒有其他路線，送貨工作完全停頓。

options.en: The village received no scheduled deliveries while the closure lasted.
options.zh: 封路期間，村莊沒有收到任何原定送貨。

reply.explanationZh: 四句都說明唯一道路封閉後村莊送貨完全停止；金句以 ground to a halt 概括。

options.en: The island’s deliveries ground to a halt when every ferry was cancelled.
options.zh: 所有渡輪停開後，小島送貨完全停頓。

options.en: The ferry ran less often, so supplies still arrived more slowly.
options.zh: 渡輪班次減少，物資仍較慢送達。

options.en: The weather changed the route, but every delivery still went ahead.
options.zh: 天氣令路線改變，但每次送貨仍照常進行。

scene.explanationZh: 所有渡輪停開、送貨暫停，符合完全停止；班次減少或改道仍有進度。
scene.promptZh: 渡輪是小島唯一的運輸方式。惡劣天氣令所有航班停開，島上送貨也暫停。哪句最貼切？

options.en: The entire show stops when the theatre loses power and has no backup.
options.zh: 劇院停電且無後備電源，整場演出停下。

options.en: The buses run every twenty minutes rather than every ten, but service continues.
options.zh: 巴士由每十分鐘一班改為每二十分鐘一班，服務仍持續。

options.en: The online service becomes unavailable to every user for the afternoon.
options.zh: 網上服務整個下午對所有使用者停用。

contrast.explanationZh: 巴士班次雖減少，但服務仍然持續，不屬完全停頓。
contrast.promptZh: 哪個情況最不適合用 ground to a halt？

options.en: The editing work has ground to a halt; we need to restore access before it can resume.
options.zh: 編輯工作已完全停頓；要恢復檔案存取才能繼續。

options.en: It sounds slower, but the team can finish today without the files.
options.zh: 看來只是慢了一點，團隊即使沒有檔案也能今天完成。

options.en: Perhaps the team should simply change the order of tasks while editing continues.
options.zh: 或許團隊只需調整工序，編輯工作便可繼續。

dialogue.explanationZh: 主系統和後備均失效，稿件完全不能處理，已不只是放慢或調整次序。
dialogue.promptZh: 朋友說：「所有編輯都打不開檔案，後備系統也失效，稿件現在完全無法處理。」你怎樣回應最貼切？

speaking.en: The ticket system ground to a halt when both the server and its backup went offline.
speaking.zh: 伺服器和後備系統同時離線後，售票系統完全停頓。
speaking.promptZh: 先聽示範，再說出為何系統無法繼續運作。

writing.promptZh: 新情境：學校演出當日，電子驗票系統故障，亦沒有紙本名單作後備；觀眾因此無法入場，驗票工作完全停止。用一至兩句英文描述原因及結果。
writing.selfCheckZh: 指出電子系統失效、沒有紙本後備，以及驗票完全停止；不要只說速度變慢。

examples.en: The electronic ticket scanner failed, and with no paper list to use, check-in ground to a halt and the audience could not enter.
examples.zh: 電子驗票機故障，又沒有紙本名單可用，驗票工作完全停頓，觀眾無法入場。

examples.en: With the online ticket system down and no printed backup, the school’s check-in ground to a halt, leaving visitors waiting outside.
examples.zh: 網上售票系統故障且沒有紙本後備，學校的驗票工作完全停頓，觀眾只能在外等候。

takeaways.en: The repairs ground to a halt when the replacement parts ran out.
takeaways.zh: 替換零件用盡後，維修工作完全停頓。

takeaways.en: Without a valid permit, the construction work may grind to a halt.
takeaways.zh: 沒有有效許可證，建築工程可能完全停頓。

notes: AI-authored provisional draft; independent English, Chinese, media and QA review remain pending.
